thread:
maya_prod: Heads-up — I'm drafting the internal announce for the release rolling tonight (v2.4.1). Need a TL;DR + 2-line exec summary and confirmation on pinning + rollback rules. Target deploy window: 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC.

maya_prod: Draft below, please quick-pass (cc @luca_oncall for oncall/rollback conf).
```
Release v2.4.1 (internal) — quick exec summary:
- What: Model-serving runtime update + batching improvements (minor weight update).
- Why: ~8-12% median token throughput improvement and improved cache hit behavior for short prompts.
- When: 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC (change window: 1h).
- Pin: model-serving:v2.4.1 (immutable artifact).
- Canary plan: 5% -> 25% after 10m -> 100% after 30m if health OK.
- Rollback criteria: p95 latency > 200ms sustained for 10m OR error rate spike > 2% OR any data loss/error in logs.
- Notes for Eng: KV cache keys changed — please watch cache-miss rate metric `runtime.kv.cache_miss` during canary.
```

ethan_eng: small nit — change p95 threshold to 250ms? we've seen brief spikes at 210 during load tests. also we should pin fallback model to model-serving:v2.4.0 in the routing policy.

joanna_docs: wording tweak for exec summary: replace "minor weight update" with "weight tuning for latency/cost tradeoff". Also add one sentence for customer-facing comms team: "No user-facing changes expected; improvements backend-only."

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2.4.1 -> cluster-prod (initiated by maya_prod). Canary policy: percentage schedule recorded. Next trigger: will start 6172839800.

maya_prod: @ethan_eng good call — updating rollback threshold to p95 > 250ms for 10m and adding fallback pin to v2.4.0. Updating draft now.

qa-bot: Staging smoke results: basic smoke OK, 1 intermittent failure on embedding pipeline (investigating). Failure not reproduced on retry. Will re-run full smoke at T-30.

luca_oncall: I'll be on standby during the window. If rollback needed, I'll coordinate with infra to pin routing and trigger rollback job. :thumbsup:

nina_comm: For internal announce, please add lines for "who to escalate to" and include a one-sentence CTA for Support: "If you see increased latency or errors, open a Severity message and ping #eng-oncall."

maya_prod: Updated draft — added who-to-escalate and adjusted wording per joanna. New snippet:
"This release optimizes runtime batching and cache behavior to reduce token unit cost and improve median throughput. No user-facing changes expected."

ethan_eng: LGTM for eng bits. Confirmed fallback routing pinned to v2.4.0 and deploybot has the policy. :+1:

joanna_docs: LGTM on copy, one micro tweak: replace "reduce token unit cost" with "reduce per-token cost" to match glossary.

maya_prod: done. Final checklist:
- [x] Docs copy reviewed (joanna)
- [x] Eng signoff (ethan)
- [ ] QA full smoke at T-30 (qa-bot)
- [x] Oncall standby (luca)
- [x] Deploybot scheduled

maya_prod: I'll post the internal announce 1 hour before the window and pin the RN in #eng-releases. If QA fails at T-30, I will abort the deploy and notify stakeholders.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: T-15m before deploy start.

qa-bot: Re-run full smoke at T-30 passed (no reproductions). Final status: smoke PASS.

maya_prod: All right — finalizing and will publish in 30m. Thanks everyone for quick pass.

ethan_eng: Thanks — will watch runtime.kv.cache_miss and runtime.latency.p95 during canary.

nina_comm: I'll prep a short internal blurb for Support and CS. Will paste into the pinned message when you post.

luca_oncall: Oncall acked — contact me with any anomalies.

maya_prod: Posted internal announce and pinned. Exec summary in the pinned message. Kicking off canary at T0.

deploy-bot: Canary step completed: 5% -> health OK. Next: 25% in 10m.

ethan_eng: Monitoring: p95 at 180ms, errors nominal. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary step completed: 25% -> health OK. Next: 100% in 20m.

maya_prod: If anyone sees concerning signals, call the rollback. Otherwise we plan to complete to 100% and close the change window.

deploy-bot: Final step: 100% -> completed. Release v2.4.1 marked successful.

maya_prod: Closing thread — will follow up with a short postmortem if any regressions crop up. Thanks all. :rocket:
